rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Art reflects society — connect any artwork discussed to its social context.
Use sensory vocabulary (vivid, expressive, evocative) when describing art.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Art questions want the FUNCTION named: expression, communication, preservation of culture, therapy — pick two and argue, not a list.  ·  Trick 2: When analysing a picture/poem in this unit, move from what you SEE to what it MEANS — observation then interpretation is the marking ladder.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: Q. Should all art be free from censorship? (2 marks) — defend expression, but accept limits where art incites harm.
